title: Due-and-Payable Appraisal Carry by Property Type — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
# Appraisal fee schedule by property type — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the due-and-payable appraisal carry, which enters the retention accrual basis, follows the property type recorded on the loan under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product.

| Property type recorded on the HECM | Due-and-payable appraisal carry |
|---|---|
| Two-to-four-unit property | USD 650.00 |
| FHA-approved condominium | USD 550.00 |
| Manufactured home | USD 550.00 |

Every other property type, and a Summit loan, which records no property type, takes no adjustment under this schedule.

**Notes to the schedule.**
- A planned unit development and a single-family home are among the other property types for this schedule.
- A two-to-four-unit HECM always takes USD 650.00, whichever plan the HECM is held under.
